name: Balkrishna Industries Ltd.
about: Balkrishna Industries Limited manufactures and sells tires under the BKT brand in India, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company provides manufacturing and selling of off-highway tires (OHT) for use in various applications, such as agriculture, construction, earthmoving, mining and quarrying, industry, and port operations. It also offers two-wheeler, passenger car radial, and commercial vehicle radial tyres, as well as carbon black. Balkrishna Industries Limited was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~23% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~6% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
Trades at PE 32 vs sector median 37; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 23, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
